mapper.insert: INSERT ALL WHEN dashboard_task_count = 0 THEN INTO inventory_sync_snapshot_task ( inventory_sync_run_id, task_type, task_status, business_date, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{runId}, 'DASHBOARD', 'PENDING', #{businessDate}, 0, 3, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP ) WHEN statistics_task_count = 0 THEN INTO inventory_sync_snapshot_task ( inventory_sync_run_id, task_type, task_status, business_date, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{runId}, 'INVENTORY_STATISTICS', 'PENDING', #{businessDate}, 0, 3, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_sync_snapshot_task WHERE inventory_sync_run_id = #{runId} AND task_type = 'DASHBOARD') AS dashboard_task_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_sync_snapshot_task WHERE inventory_sync_run_id = #{runId} AND task_type = 'INVENTORY_STATISTICS') AS statistics_task_count FROM dual
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inventory_sync_snapshot_task WHERE inventory_sync_run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY task_type

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT task.* FROM inventory_sync_snapshot_task task WHERE ( task.task_status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND task.next_attempt_at <= SYSTIMESTAMP AND task.attempt_count < task.max_attempts ) OR ( task.task_status = 'RUNNING' AND task.lease_expires_at <= SYSTIMESTAMP AND task.attempt_count < task.max_attempts ) ORDER BY task.next_attempt_at, task.inventory_sync_snapshot_task_id ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_sync_snapshot_task SET task_status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_owner_instance_id = #{owner}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, SYSTIMESTAMP), last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE inventory_sync_run_id = #{runId} AND task_type = #{taskType} AND attempt_count < max_attempts AND ( (task_status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND next_attempt_at <= SYSTIMESTAMP) OR (task_status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at <= SYSTIMESTAMP) )

UPDATE inventory_sync_snapshot_task task SET task_status = 'SUCCEEDED', completed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, lease_owner_instance_id = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE task.task_status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT', 'FAILED') AND ( (task.task_type = 'DASHBOARD' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dashboard_snapshot snapshot WHERE snapshot.sync_job_id = task.inventory_sync_run_id AND snapshot.is_deleted = 0 )) OR (task.task_type = 'INVENTORY_STATISTICS' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM statistics_snapshot snapshot WHERE snapshot.sync_job_id = task.inventory_sync_run_id AND snapshot.is_deleted = 0 )) )

UPDATE inventory_sync_snapshot_task SET task_status = 'FAILED', completed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, lease_owner_instance_id = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, last_error_code = 'SNAPSHOT_WORKER_LEASE_EXPIRED', last_error_message = '마지막 재시도 중 worker lease가 만료되었습니다.', updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE task_status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at <= SYSTIMESTAMP AND attempt_count >= max_attempts
